marks.source_label: Wikipedia: Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting, Gun control

marks.label: Connecticut's gun law
marks.title: Connecticut passes a 139-page gun law with the first dangerous-weapon offender registry
marks.sentence: On April 3, 2013, the Connecticut General Assembly passed a 139-page major gun-control bill with broad bipartisan support. It also created the first registry in the United States for dangerous-weapon offenders, and added over 100 types of guns to the state's assault weapons ban.
